# @amykit/plugin-agent-desktop

Drives a desktop app through agent-desktop: snapshot its accessibility tree and act on its refs.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy).

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-agent-desktop
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-agent-desktop"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-agent-desktop":
    binary: "agent-desktop"
    timeoutMs: 60000
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `binary` | `string` | no | `agent-desktop` | the agent-desktop command, or a path to it |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | no | `60000` | how long one agent-desktop command may run |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
